To achieve this, we will rely on a robust research methodology that combines archival research at institutional and corporate archives with fieldwork among private collectors to obtain high-resolution images of label variants and run-out grooves.

The project timeline is carefully designed to accommodate seasonal constraints and ensure timely collaboration with the reissue label to verify rights and obtain necessary permissions.

Our deliverables will include an illustrated annotated discography with item-level metadata, an authoritative liner-note text, and an online companion with high-resolution images and explanatory annotations.
